Size: 65% of the principal dwelling's floor area or 1,000 sq ft, whichever is greater, never larger than the principal dwelling: adu_max_sqft=1000 is the floor of that cap. Text read from Exhibit A as attached in Legistar; whether the 2025-11-24 Council amendment changed it was not checked. Second coder (2026-10-18): confirmed; the 2025-11-24 Council amendment made no text change. ADUs were already allowed outside Title 33's residential districts before this (TND districts since Ord. 1518-01/1627-02, Downtown, East Franklinton: the city's 2025 hearing presentation), so this row is a broadening to the residential districts.
